title: Three separate tutorial systems fire at once on a first run, and the second one tells the user to do what they just did
reasoning: All three claimed causes are present in code, not just in the summary. (a) FirstLaunchTourDao.getStatus() (packages/skotiq_core/lib/src/providers/tutorial_provider.dart:270-291) returns FirstLaunchTourStatus.notStarted for a missing progress row, and reset() writes a fresh row precisely so an explicit replay request is distinguishable from a fresh install. (b) ContextualTourPrompt._checkAndShowPrompt gates on _coachMarkTourOnScreen (the same `pending` status the overlay launcher uses). (c) The new session-scoped guidedFlowActiveProvider (tutorial_provider.dart:207) is claimed by FirstNightWizard in a post-frame callback in initState and released only in onClose, _handleSkipForever and _handleDone -- not in dispose, so the '_handleShowMe' deep-link pop keeps the claim. The consumer side gates in _checkAndShowPrompt AND has a ref.listen that calls _hideForCompetingFlow (which cancels _showDelayTimer BEFORE the `if (!_isVisible) return`, so a nudge still inside its 500ms fade-in delay is also stopped) without spending the persisted dismissal. Not disclosure-only and not relocated: the nudge does not appear at all.
evidence: Ran packages/skotiq_app/test/screens/tutorial/first_night_wizard_guided_flow_test.dart + test/widgets/contextual_tour_prompt_guided_flow_test.dart: 7/7 green. SEVER: commented out `ref.read(guidedFlowActiveProvider.notifier).state = true;` in first_night_wizard.dart initState AND replaced `ref.read(guidedFlowActiveProvider) ||` with `false ||` in contextual_tour_prompt.dart:145 -> 4 of 7 failed (3 producer-side, plus 'the nudge stands down while the walkthrough is running'). Both edits restored and verified absent by grep. Residual noted but not scored as a defect: once the user follows a 'Show me on the X screen' deep link the claim is held for the rest of the app session (release only happens if they reopen the walkthrough and Done/Skip/Close it), so every per-screen nudge on every screen stays suppressed until relaunch. That is deliberate, documented at tutorial_provider.dart:195-206, session-scoped (StateProvider, not persisted) and does not spend any dismissal.

title: The onboarding step list marks a step complete just for visiting it
reasoning: The claimed code is at packages/skotiq_app/lib/screens/onboarding/onboarding_screen.dart:982 (class _StepSidebar extends ConsumerWidget, taking `final OnboardingDraft draft`) and :1052-1054 -- `isCompleted = isPassed && draft.producedValueFor(step, siteConfigured: siteConfigured)`, with isSkipped = isPassed && !isCompleted rendering SkotiqIcons.remove on colors.surfaceAlt instead of a filled primary tick. The four tooltips ('Configured' / 'Skipped -- nothing was set' / 'Current step' / 'Not reached yet') are all there. siteConfigured is read from appSettingsProvider with the null-island (0,0) sentinel, matching the Review screen's rule rather than the draft. producedValueFor is a real per-step value test in packages/skotiq_core/lib/src/models/onboarding/onboarding_state.dart:312-343 (cameraId != null, guiderId != null, focalLengthMm != null, any of the five camera defaults, non-blank captureDirectory, etc.), not a re-labelling of the visited flag. The trailing optional-step dash is now guarded by `if (step.isOptional && !isPassed)`. The sidebar is wide-layout-only; the phone layout uses a 'Step N of M' header with no ticks, so there is no second uncovered surface.
evidence: Ran test/screens/onboarding/onboarding_steps_test.dart: 19/19 green, including 'step list ticks only the steps that captured a value' which drives the real wizard to Review with only camera/mount/optics/capture-dir set and asserts 6 Configured / 5 Skipped / 1 Current. SEVER: replaced the isCompleted expression with the old `isCompleted = isPassed` -> that test fails with 'Expected: exactly 6 matching candidates / Actual: Found 11 widgets', i.e. the pre-fix behaviour is caught. Restored and re-grepped.

title: The Tonight screen hedges about a fact it knows: "may be below your horizon or your location is not set"
reasoning: Every cited seam is real. packages/skotiq_core/lib/src/providers/target_suggestion_provider.dart returns [] when latitude==0.0 && longitude==0.0 before any sky work, so a null pick with an unset site is not 'the sky is empty'. tonight_screen.dart:696-737 is a new _NoPickCard ConsumerWidget that watches appSettingsProvider and branches: unset site -> 'Location not configured' + 'Open Settings' -> context.go('/settings?section=location'); configured site -> 'Nothing imageable right now' with Refresh kept. I checked the deep link actually lands: app_router.dart:336 forwards uri.queryParameters['section'] to SettingsScreen.initialSection, resolveSectionKey (settings_catalog.dart:718) resolves it against _structuralGroups, and 'location' is a real section key (settings_catalog.dart:160, listed at :787). So the new button is not a dead end -- it is the concrete fix, not a re-worded label. The GO path is fixed at the same cause: the pick seam in tonight_screen.dart:40-51 reads appSettingsProvider itself and throws NoTonightTargetException with a message that names the unset location, and the exception's default (one_tap_tonight_controller.dart:97-100) was narrowed to the genuinely ambiguous 'nothing clears your horizon and moon limits' case with no location clause. Grep confirms no other live surface still carries the old hedge.
evidence: Ran test/screens/tonight/ : 10/10 green, including the new tonight_no_pick_cause_test.dart which drives the real TonightBodyView with a null pick under both an unset AppSettingsState and lat 40/lon -75. SEVER: replaced the locationUnset expression in _NoPickCard with `settings != null && false` -> 'no pick with an unset location names the location' fails ('Found 0 widgets with text "Location not configured"'). Restored and grep-verified. Caveat noted, not scored: the GO-path branch (tonight_screen.dart:40-51) ships NO test -- it lives inside the private _liveController() closure -- so only the card branch is regression-protected. Also, while appSettingsProvider is still loading, valueOrNull is null and the card shows the configured-site copy for that frame.

title: "Unattended Autopilot" panel title is permanently truncated
reasoning: The claim about the earlier pass being incomplete is TRUE and I reproduced it rather than taking it on faith. The panel width clamp the summary cites is real (scheduler_tab_content.dart:415-417: fraction 0.28, min 280, max 380), so every window from the desktop breakpoint to ~1170 px sits on the 280 px floor. decision_panel.dart:49-73 now reads Row[Icon, Expanded(Wrap(spacing/runSpacing, WrapCrossAlignment.center)[Text('Unattended Autopilot', maxLines:2, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis), _StateBadge])], i.e. the badge no longer competes for the title's line -- that is the cause the finding named, not a threshold nudge. The explicit TextOverflow.ellipsis matters because Flutter defaults to clip once maxLines is set.
evidence: Ran test/screens/planner/widgets/scheduler_tab_content_test.dart: 13/13 green, with two width cases (1280 and 1050 -> the 280 px floor), the narrow one asserting didExceedMaxLines==false, overflow==TextOverflow.ellipsis, AND that the 'Running' badge's top is at/below the title's bottom (i.e. it really wrapped to its own run). SEVER: restored the pre-fix shape by hand -- Flexible(Text(maxLines:2, ellipsis)) + SizedBox + _StateBadge in the Row -- and the 280 px test failed with 'Expected: false / Actual: <true>' on didExceedMaxLines while the 1280 px test still PASSED, which independently confirms the earlier maxLines:2-only pass was measured at a width that hid the residual. Restored. Regression check: test/screens/scheduler/ 18/18 green, no overflow errors in either run.

title: PolarAlignmentNode cannot be added to a sequence - it is absent from the palette
reasoning: The palette entry exists at packages/skotiq_core/lib/src/providers/sequence/node_palette.dart:326-334, in the Mount category immediately after Meridian Flip, createNode: () => PolarAlignmentNode(isNorth: (appSettings?.latitude ?? 0.0) >= 0), where appSettings comes from ref.watch(appSettingsProvider).valueOrNull at :108 so the palette rebuilds when the site changes. This is the ONE data source for every palette surface -- sequencer_screen.dart:148, sequencer_screen_parts/node_palette.dart:30, widgets/node_palette.dart:55 and sequence_tree_context_menu.dart:644 all ref.watch(nodePaletteProvider) -- so a single entry reaches the toolbox tab, the desktop sidebar, the mobile add sheet and the tree context menu; no surface is missed. The 'compass' icon name is mapped in palette_icon_map.dart:28, so it renders a real glyph rather than a fallback. The node is genuinely runnable once added: serialization_operations.dart:657 emits {'type': 'PolarAlignment', ...} and the Rust factory key at native/skotiq_native/sequencer/src/node/registry.rs:113 is exactly "PolarAlignment".
evidence: Ran packages/skotiq_core/test/providers/sequence/node_palette_polar_alignment_test.dart against the real nodePaletteProvider (no fake palette): 4/4 green, covering reachability, search-by-'polar', and isNorth true at +41.5 / false at -33.9. SEVER: renamed the palette entry to 'SEVERED Polar Alignment' -> 3 of 4 tests failed; restored. Nit noted, not scored: the summary says isNorth follows 'the same way SmartNightService derives it', but the palette inlines `(lat ?? 0.0) >= 0` rather than calling latitudeSign(); the two agree for every real settings value and differ only for a non-finite latitude (latitudeSign returns true, the inline expression would return false).

title: Palette search with no matches renders a completely blank panel
reasoning: The shared widget is real (packages/skotiq_app/lib/screens/sequencer/widgets/node_palette_empty_state.dart) and does what the summary says: LucideIcons.searchX, 'No nodes match "<trimmed query>"', a what-to-try line, and a SkotiqButton('Clear search') wired to an onClear the caller supplies. I enumerated every production call site of rankNodePaletteMatches rather than trusting the summary's count, and there are FOUR, not three -- sequencer_screen_parts/node_palette.dart:35, widgets/node_palette.dart:60 (two render branches: desktop sidebar :351 and mobile sheet :186), and widgets/sequence_tree_context_menu.dart:651 (the Insert picker). ALL FOUR now guard with `isEmpty ? NodePaletteEmptyState(...) : ListView...`, so the fourth surface the summary undercounted is covered too. Each onClear clears the real TextEditingController AND resets the query state, so the button restores the catalogue rather than only repainting. Checked the RELOCATED risk explicitly -- an empty query returns the categories unchanged (same(categories)) so a genuinely empty palette would show 'No nodes match ""' -- but nodePaletteProvider builds its categories unconditionally from literals, so it cannot be empty; the new copy cannot become a different false claim.
evidence: Ran test/screens/sequencer/node_palette_empty_state_test.dart + test/screens/sequencer/sequence_tree_context_menu_test.dart: 17/17 green. The toolbox test also taps 'Clear search' and asserts the categories come back ('Imaging' findsWidgets). SEVER: replaced the guard condition with a literal false at all four sites (filteredCategories.isEmpty x3, filtered.isEmpty x1) -> exactly four tests failed: 'toolbox Nodes tab explains a search that matches nothing', 'desktop sidebar palette explains an empty result', 'mobile sheet palette explains an empty result', 'Insert picker explains a search that matches nothing'. All restored; grep for the marker returns nothing.

title: UI scale dropdown truncates its own selected value to 'Extra Lar...' at large UI scale
reasoning: Present and load-bearing. SkotiqDropdown now exposes `static const TextStyle labelStyle = TextStyle(fontSize: 12)` and `static const double chromeWidth = 12 + 12 + 14 + 2` (skotiq_dropdown.dart:30,34) and paints with `labelStyle.copyWith(color: ...)` at :65, so the measurement and the paint share one style -- and because DropdownButton REPLACES the DefaultTextStyle with that style, the TextPainter and the rendered label also share a font family. _SettingsDropdownState._widestLabelWidth (settings_switch_and_dropdown.dart:234-253) lays out every itemLabel with a TextPainter at MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context), and build() takes math.max(designWidth, widest + chromeWidth) inside a LayoutBuilder that clamps to constraints.maxWidth. I checked that clamp is not inert: SettingRow puts the trailing control in `Flexible(child: Align(...))` (settings_section_and_row.dart:314-316), so the constraints ARE bounded and the control cannot trade an ellipsis for an overflow stripe. The widest-not-selected choice is in the code, so the control does not resize when the selection changes. The root-cause claim also checks out: app.dart:44 maps 'Extra Large (1.4x)' into a text scaler, so the defect was latent for every SettingsDropdown.
evidence: Ran test/screens/settings/settings_dropdown_value_fit_test.dart + settings_dropdown_test.dart: 4/4 green. The fit test compares RenderParagraph.getMaxIntrinsicWidth against the width actually granted, once at 1.0x and once under MediaQuery(textScaler: 1.4). SEVER: replaced `var width = math.max(effectiveWidth, needed)` with `var width = effectiveWidth` -> both fit tests failed with the real defect numbers, 'needs 216.0, has 100.0' at 1.0x and 'needs 302.34, has 0.0' at 1.4x. Restored. REGRESSION SWEEP: ran the whole test/screens/settings/ directory (458 tests) -- 2 failures, both in captures_landscape_test.dart and both GOLDEN pixel diffs (settings_android_landscape_932x430.png 4.38%/17535px, settings_android_portrait_430x932.png 8.70%/34883px). I re-ran that file with the fix severed back to the pre-fix width and got byte-identical diff figures, so those goldens are pre-existing (the repo's goldens are Windows-captured) and NOT caused by this fix.

title: Enter does not submit the profile dialogs, so the fastest path through them is mouse-only
reasoning: Both edits are in the file at the cited spots: the Create dialog's name field (screen_shell.dart:760-768) and the Duplicate dialog's single field (:888-896) each carry `textInputAction: TextInputAction.done` + `onSubmitted: (_) => _submit()`, calling the exact same _submit the primary button's onPressed calls -- so no validation is bypassed. I read both _submit bodies: empty/whitespace still sets 'Enter a profile name.' and returns without popping, and Duplicate's still refuses a normalizeProfileName collision with 'Another profile is already called "x"'. The Create dialog's description field is genuinely untouched and is maxLines: 2, so Return there stays a newline as claimed. I looked for a missed sibling surface: the only other place that gates a profile name is packages/skotiq_app/lib/screens/equipment/dialogs/profile_editor_dialog/profile_data_operations.dart:371, which belongs to the multi-field profile EDITOR, not a one-field commit dialog, so it is outside this finding's shape.

It drives the real screen (open the row menu -> Duplicate; tap 'New Profile') and commits with tester.testTextInput.receiveAction(TextInputAction.done) -- the hardware-Return path -- never tapping the action button, then asserts the notifier recorded the create/duplicate AND that the dialog closed. SEVER: removed both `onSubmitted: (_) => _submit(),` lines -> all three tests failed (duplicated [] vs ['Adv Rig One (Copy)'], created [] vs ['Widefield'], and the empty-name error text absent). Restored; re-ran with equipment_profile_duplicate_name_test.dart and equipment_profile_create_refresh_test.dart: 10/10 green.
